quotes.quote: Yes, fast food restaurants are included in the restaurant rewards category.
This category's merchants’ primary business is sit-down or eat-in dining, including fast food restaurants and fine dining establishments.
Includes purchases at cafes, bars, lounges, fast-food restaurants, restaurant delivery services, and take out restaurants.
Restaurant purchases include those made at merchants classified as full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, and caterers.
